title: Service Infrastructure Metrics
description: CPU, memory, network, disk I/O, requests and limits of the team's rg namespace and workspace pods, and the rg namespace volumes. Federated by the team collector from the platform Prometheus recording rules (rg_pod:, rg_pvc:, workspace_pod:).

list.name: pod
list.label: Pod
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT if(startsWith(MetricName, 'workspace_pod:'), concat(Attributes['label_workspace_id'], '-', if(Attributes['label_server_name'] = '', 'vm', Attributes['label_server_name']), '-', arrayElement(splitByChar('-', Attributes['pod']), -1)), Attributes['pod']) FROM otel_metrics_gauge WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ServiceName = 'platform-prometheus' AND MetricName IN ('rg_pod:container_memory_working_set_bytes', 'workspace_pod:container_memory_working_set_bytes') ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  name AS Pod,
  sumIf(v, k = 'cpu') AS CPU,
  sumIf(v, k = 'cpu_request') AS `CPU request`,
  sumIf(v, k = 'cpu_limit') AS `CPU limit`,
  sumIf(v, k = 'memory') AS `Memory (working set)`,
  sumIf(v, k = 'memory_request') AS `Memory request`,
  sumIf(v, k = 'memory_limit') AS `Memory limit`,
  max(at) AS `Last seen`
FROM (
  -- latest sample per container, pods gone for more than 2 minutes are left out
  SELECT if(startsWith(MetricName, 'workspace_pod:'), concat(Attributes['label_workspace_id'], '-', if(Attributes['label_server_name'] = '', 'vm', Attributes['label_server_name']), '-', arrayElement(splitByChar('-', Attributes['pod']), -1)), Attributes['pod']) AS name, Attributes['container'] AS container,
         multiIf(MetricName LIKE '%cpu_usage%', 'cpu',
                 MetricName LIKE '%memory_working_set%', 'memory',
                 concat(Attributes['resource'], '_', if(MetricName LIKE '%requests', 'request', 'limit'))) AS k,
         argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v, max(TimeUnix) AS at
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND ServiceName = 'platform-prometheus'
    AND MetricName IN ('rg_pod:container_cpu_usage_seconds:rate5m', 'workspace_pod:container_cpu_usage_seconds:rate5m', 'rg_pod:container_memory_working_set_bytes', 'workspace_pod:container_memory_working_set_bytes', 'rg_pod:kube_pod_container_resource_requests', 'workspace_pod:kube_pod_container_resource_requests', 'rg_pod:kube_pod_container_resource_limits', 'workspace_pod:kube_pod_container_resource_limits')
    AND (MetricName NOT LIKE '%resource%' OR Attributes['resource'] IN ('cpu', 'memory'))
    AND if(startsWith(MetricName, 'workspace_pod:'), concat(Attributes['label_workspace_id'], '-', if(Attributes['label_server_name'] = '', 'vm', Attributes['label_server_name']), '-', arrayElement(splitByChar('-', Attributes['pod']), -1)), Attributes['pod']) IN (${pod:singlequote})
  GROUP BY name, container, k
  HAVING at > now() - INTERVAL 2 MINUTE
)
GROUP BY name
ORDER BY name

SELECT $__timeInterval(t) AS time, series, avg(v) AS value
FROM (
  -- the recorded series are already rates, summed over the containers per scrape
  SELECT TimeUnix AS t, if(startsWith(MetricName, 'workspace_pod:'), concat(Attributes['label_workspace_id'], '-', if(Attributes['label_server_name'] = '', 'vm', Attributes['label_server_name']), '-', arrayElement(splitByChar('-', Attributes['pod']), -1)), Attributes['pod']) AS series, sum(Value) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND ServiceName = 'platform-prometheus'
    AND MetricName IN ('rg_pod:container_cpu_usage_seconds:rate5m', 'workspace_pod:container_cpu_usage_seconds:rate5m')
    AND if(startsWith(MetricName, 'workspace_pod:'), concat(Attributes['label_workspace_id'], '-', if(Attributes['label_server_name'] = '', 'vm', Attributes['label_server_name']), '-', arrayElement(splitByChar('-', Attributes['pod']), -1)), Attributes['pod']) IN (${pod:singlequote})
  GROUP BY t, series
)
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

SELECT
  claim AS Volume,
  anyIf(v, MetricName = 'rg_pvc:kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes') AS Capacity,
  anyIf(v, MetricName = 'rg_pvc:kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes') AS Used,
  Used / nullIf(Capacity, 0) AS `Used %`
FROM (
  -- the volume series carry the claim but no pod
  SELECT Attributes['persistentvolumeclaim'] AS claim, MetricName, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS v
  FROM otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE TimeUnix > now() - INTERVAL 10 MINUTE AND ServiceName = 'platform-prometheus'
    AND MetricName IN ('rg_pvc:kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes', 'rg_pvc:kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes')
  GROUP BY claim, MetricName
)
GROUP BY claim
ORDER BY `Used %` DESC
